# LobbyDuo

> LobbyDuo is an independent web tool at migosai.design for creating Hotel Lobby–style duo performance videos from two photos and Ozil goal–style football clips from one photo. Users can choose a stage, model, sound and motion reference. Google sign-in and sufficient generation credits are required. LobbyDuo is not affiliated with migosai.com, Migos, Quavo, Takeoff, Quality Control Music or COLORS.

## Core pages
- [Hotel Lobby AI Video Generator](https://migosai.design/hotel-lobby-ai-video-generator): The interactive two-photo generator, three-step guide, photo requirements, reference gallery and FAQ.
- [Free Hotel Lobby AI Video Generator? Credits and Limits](https://migosai.design/hotel-lobby-ai-video-generator-free): Explains why generation requires paid credits, current video costs and watermark handling. Registration does not include free credits.
- [Hotel Lobby AI Template](https://migosai.design/hotel-lobby-ai-template): Supported durations, aspect ratios, resolution options and suggested configurations for the built-in template.

- [Hotel Lobby AI Generator](https://migosai.design/hotel-lobby-ai-generator): A quick guide to choosing a workflow, preparing photos and selecting video settings.
- [Best Hotel Lobby AI Video Generators: 2026 Comparison](https://migosai.design/blog/best-hotel-lobby-ai-video-generators-2026): The official LobbyDuo blog compares nine tools using their public documentation. Authorship is disclosed; no independent output-quality ranking or numerical ratings are claimed.
- [LobbyDuo Blog](https://migosai.design/blog): Guides to the Hotel Lobby AI trend, available in English, Korean, Japanese, French, Spanish and Traditional Chinese.
- [What Is a Hotel Lobby AI Video?](https://migosai.design/blog/what-is-hotel-lobby-ai-video): Defines the trend (two people, pets or characters in the orange booth from Quavo and Takeoff's 2022 A COLORS SHOW performance of "HOTEL LOBBY (Unc & Phew)"), its September 2026 origin, why it went viral and the three ways to make one.
- [What Song Is in the Hotel Lobby AI Trend?](https://migosai.design/blog/hotel-lobby-ai-trend-song): Song facts and step-by-step instructions for adding the "Hotel Lobby" sound on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, plus LobbyDuo's sound options.
- [Hotel Lobby AI Video With Your Cat or Dog](https://migosai.design/blog/hotel-lobby-ai-video-cat-dog): Pet duo ideas, a pet photo checklist, steps with LobbyDuo and fixes for orange fur, dark fur and swapped sides.
- [Hotel Lobby AI Video Problems and Fixes](https://migosai.design/blog/hotel-lobby-ai-video-problems-fixes): Causes and fixes for blended faces, wrong identities, swapped sides, extra people, silent clips, rejected uploads and stalled progress.
- [Reference Examples](https://migosai.design/showcases): Three unedited videos generated with LobbyDuo's Wan 3.0 Hotel Lobby template from original character photos, followed by third-party clips of the trend that link to their original creators. Third-party clips are not LobbyDuo output.

## Ozil Goal facts
- Input: one photo of one consenting adult, ideally head to toe with the face visible. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. No prompt or editing.
- Output: a 15-second vertical 9:16 MP4 with sound at 768p, generated with MiniMax H3 from a fixed motion reference.
- Each Ozil video costs 300 credits from the same balance used by the other LobbyDuo generators, so the 300-credit Starter pack covers one Ozil video. Failed generations return credits. Generation time varies.
- The sample video on the page is an original reference sample made from an AI-generated portrait, not a customer result. Movement, timing, clothing and identity vary between renders; keeping your own clothes is likely, not guaranteed.
- LobbyDuo does not add its own watermark to Ozil videos. LobbyDuo is not affiliated with Mesut Özil or any player, club, league, federation or broadcaster. Do not upload footballers, celebrities, public figures, children or anyone who has not agreed.

## Product facts
- Two separate images are used, one for each performer. JPG, PNG and WebP are accepted, up to 10 MB each.
- Models: Wan 3.0, Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast. Stages: Hotel Lobby, Luxury lobby, Recording studio and Street cypher. Wan uses the Hotel Lobby stage; the other stages use Seedance original audio.
- Template duration choices: 5, 8, 10, 12 or 15 seconds. Uploaded motion clips can determine duration within the selected model's limits. Aspect ratios: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3 or 3:4. Resolutions: 480p, 720p or 1080p; Seedance Fast supports up to 720p.
- Sound choices: template soundtrack, an uploaded song, audio extracted from a motion clip, or original AI rap with an optional topic. Browsers prepare the selected short segment before uploading it. References guide generation; exact audio copying or identical movement is not guaranteed.
- The default Wan template video is 10 seconds at 480p and costs 30 credits. A 5-second 480p template video costs 15 credits with Wan, 50 with Seedance or 40 with Seedance Fast. The built-in Wan template uses the uploaded photo identities, text choreography and template audio without a reference video. Uploaded motion clips add their validated reference-video duration to the output duration for Wan billing; the server calculates the final quote.
- New accounts start with 0 credits. Registration and sign-in do not grant credits. Purchase a one-time credit pack before generating; existing account balances remain available. No subscription or automatic renewal is required. No daily free-video allowance is offered. Check the generator's quote before submitting.
- LobbyDuo does not add its own watermark. This does not guarantee that source material or provider output contains no marks.
- Processing includes upload, generation and review. Video duration is not a promise about completion time.
- New video requests use Kie. APIMart processes music and historical video jobs. SeeAPI reviews generated video results before delivery; this is not a claim that every prompt or uploaded image is screened.
- Upload only authorized material with the consent of each person depicted. Unauthorized celebrity or public-figure impersonation and misleading endorsements are prohibited.
- Support, refunds, privacy requests, and content reports: cuilinhao2021@gmail.com.

## FAQ
- Q: Can I generate a complete Hotel Lobby AI video for free here? A: No. New accounts receive no free credits. Purchase a one-time credit pack and check that your balance covers the selected settings before generating. The default 10-second Wan template costs 30 credits. Existing account balances remain available.
- Q: Do I need to write a prompt? A: No. Scene instructions are built in. For original AI rap, a topic is optional.
- Q: Do both people need to appear in one photo? A: No. Add one photo per performer to the two upload slots.
- Q: Is this an official artist or COLORS product? A: No. LobbyDuo is an independent tool; descriptive references do not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- Q: Is LobbyDuo the same as migosai.com? A: No. LobbyDuo runs at migosai.design and is operated independently of migosai.com and any other similarly named service.

Content reviewed: 2026-10-15. Check the linked pages and generator for current settings and costs.

## Gangnam Style pages and product facts
- [Gangnam Style AI Video Generator](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator): The interactive generator and feature guide for friends, one-selfie and pet trio videos, with photo uploads, quality selection, examples, credits and FAQ. This page has its own canonical URL; the MigosAI homepage remains the Hotel Lobby generator.
- Friends mode takes three separate photos, ordered middle, right and left. Selfie mode uses one selfie as the identity for all three dancers. Pets mode takes three separate pet photos in the same role order.
- New output is a landscape 16:9 MP4 with the trio reference clip's template soundtrack. It follows an approximately 15-second reference; the finished duration can vary slightly and may be shorter. Choose 480p for 150 credits or 720p for 300 credits from the shared MigosAI balance. Check the generator's current quote before submitting.
- The template soundtrack is added during processing. It is not a complete original-song download or a promise of music-use permission on other platforms. This workflow has no separate custom-song control. Third-party sample videos are attributed to gangnamstyle.io.
- [Gangnam Style Blog](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog): A dedicated index of ten Gangnam Style guides. The main /blog remains the Hotel Lobby blog; Gangnam articles keep their nested /gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/ paths.

## Gangnam Style guides
- [What Is Gangnam Style? The Song, Dance and AI Trio Explained](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/what-is-gangnam-style): Distinguishes PSY's song and dance from the photo-based AI trio format.

- [How to Make a Gangnam Style AI Video from One Selfie](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/gangnam-style-ai-video-from-one-selfie): Shows how one selfie supplies the identity for three dancers and what to inspect in the result.
- [How to Make a Gangnam Style AI Pet Video with Three Photos](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/gangnam-style-ai-pet-video): Explains how to prepare three pet photos and review markings, role order and movement.
- [Gangnam Style AI Video Prompts: Three Friends, One Selfie and Pets](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/gangnam-style-ai-video-prompt): Provides the three complete prompts with photo-role mapping, shot timings and soundtrack workflow.
- [Gangnam Style AI Video Music: What Sound Is Included?](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/gangnam-style-ai-video-music): Explains the included template soundtrack, playback checks and the difference between audio inclusion and publishing permission.
- [Gangnam Style AI Video Format and Resolution: 480p or 720p?](https://migosai.design/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/gangnam-style-ai-video-format-resolution): Compares resolution, fixed 16:9 framing, approximate duration and cropping considerations.

## Gangnam Style language and discovery
- The generator, its blog index and all ten guides are available in English, Korean, Japanese, French, Spanish and Traditional Chinese. English uses the original path; the other versions use /ko, /ja, /fr, /es and /zh-TW prefixes.
- Every translated page uses its own canonical URL with reciprocal language alternatives and an English x-default. Example: https://migosai.design/ja/gangnam-style-ai-video-generator/blog/what-is-gangnam-style.
- [Sitemap](https://migosai.design/sitemap.xml): Current MigosAI public pages and their language URLs, including the original Hotel Lobby and dedicated Gangnam Style routes.
